title: Project
description: A software project and the role held on it. Each record is one JSON file under projects/.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, so editors can validate and autocomplete the record.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema that the record follows.

url.description: Primary link for the project, such as its source repository or homepage.

role.description: Role held on the project, e.g. "Lead Developer" or "Contributor".

contribution.description: Summary of the contributions made to the project. Required when the role is "Contributor".

startDate.description: When involvement in the project began.

endDate.description: When involvement in the project ended. Omitted while it is ongoing.

logo.description: Path to the project's logo relative to the website root (the file itself lives under src/public/), e.g. "img/guide_logo.png".

description.description: Paragraphs of plain text describing the project and the contributions made to it. **Double asterisks** mark emphasis.

date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date at year (YYYY), month (YYYY-MM) or day (YYYY-MM-DD) precision.
